lines.intro: Your apps. Your tabs. A little more private.
lines.web: Open the extension. Choose Lock this site.
lines.touch: Touch ID opens automatically. One touch, and you're back in.
lines.app: For Mac apps, choose Lock an app. Then click its window.
lines.blur: Blurred until you unlock. Your window stays right there.
lines.active: Switch freely. Every action resets the five-minute timer.
lines.idle: Five minutes away? Everything locks again.
lines.end: Open Locker. Open source. Local. Yours.
